output_list.reason: The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The condition '_amount > 0 && balances[_to] + _amount > balances[_to]' can be exploited to overflow the balance of '_to' and set it to a target value.

The 'approve' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the addition of _amount to allowed[msg.sender][_spender] causes an overflow, allowing it to be exploited to increase the allowance arbitrarily.
